items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence:
Breadcrumb is plain text:
Hợp đồng / HD-2026-0142
, with no link back to the list. Header does show the number, vendor, badge 'Đang hiệu lực' and 4 KPI cards, but the breadcrumb does not lead back.

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: Single blue primary 'Gia hạn hợp đồng'; 'In / Xuất PDF' is a secondary outline button. Audit headerPrimaryActions=1. No edit or terminate action exists.

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a `mailto:` link and phone as a `tel:` link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: #contactList cards show name and role, a[href^='mailto:'] and a[href^='tel:'], and the 'Đầu mối chính' text tag on Trần Quốc Bảo.

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: Amount cells are text-right tabular-nums with vi-VN formatting (header 'Số tiền (VND)'), but rows are in chronological order M1..M6, with paid ones first and overdue M4 in fourth place.

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: Status badges carry the text 'Quá hạn' and 'Chưa đến hạn' (renderPay). There is no day count, but text is present.

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: Alert: 'Hợp đồng hết hạn sau 70 ngày (14/01/2027)'; KPI 'Hiệu lực 15/01/2026 – 14/01/2027' and 'Còn lại 70 ngày'.

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
items.evidence: Appendices (PL-03, PL-04) and the renewal timeline have number, absolute date and summary, but no approver anywhere.

items.item: Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: Only the terms and payments filters have a bare empty message ('Không tìm thấy điều khoản phù hợp.', 'Không có mốc nào.') with no action. There is no loading or error/retry state anywhere in the script.

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: There is no terminate action or confirmation dialog. The only modal is renewModal.

notes: Audit score 90 (only icon-chevron contrast violations). The page is clean and dense but is missing breadcrumb links, milestone ordering by urgency, an approver column, state handling (loading/error/empty actions) and a terminate flow. Sidebar is slate-900 with blue accents. Contact cards sit inside a bordered section card. There are no gradients, glass, emoji, hover-lift or oversized radii.
